5(2)-ABA-1432-2025.odt
IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO.1432 OF 2025
Priti Atul Mehta & Ors. ...Applicants
Versus
The State of Maharashtra & Anr. ...Respondents
_______________________________________________________
Ms. Keral Mehta a/w Mr. Arun Mehta, for the Applicants.
Mr. Sameer M. Mangaonkar,  APP for Respondent-State.
Ms. Simta Jadhav, WPSI, Borivali Police Station is present in
Court.
_______________________________________________________
        CORAM :  ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.
          DATE     :  27th MAY, 2025
P.C. :-
1. Heard Ms. Keral Mehta along with  Mr. Arun Mehta,
learned  Advocate  for  the  Applicants  and  Mr.  Sameer  M.
Mangaonkar, learned APP for the Respondent-State.
2. Subject  of  the  present  Application  pertains  to
matrimonial discord.  Ms. Keral Mehta seeks leave to join t he
Complainant as a party to the present proceeding. 
3. Learned APP had also raised an objection to the non-
joinder  of  the  Complainant  as  a  party  to  the  present
KARTIKEYA          1 of  2

5(2)-ABA-1432-2025.odt
proceeding.
4. In view of the submissions of Ms. Keral Mehta, learned
Advocate for the Applicants and the objection as raised by
learned  APP ,  leave  granted  to  join  the  Complainant  as
Respondent No.2 in the present proceeding. Amendment to be
carried out forthwith.
5. Upon  amendment,  Issue  notice  to  Respondent  No.2.
Applicants to take step to pay the process fees and furnish  the
paper-book so as to effect the service on the newly added
Respondent No.2.
6. In  addition  to  regular  mode  of  service,  Applicant  is
permitted to serve the private notice on the Respondent No .2
indicating filing of the present Application and the ne xt date
fixed  in  this  Application.  Applicant  to  file  an  affidavit  of
service on or before the returnable date.
7. List the matter for further consideration on  
02.06.2025
at 11.00 a.m., subject to service on the party.
   [ ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J. ]
KARTIKEYA          2 of  2
